title: Global Underutilization of Antiviral Therapy and Survival Outcomes in Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 78 Studies and 68,243 Patients.
abstract: Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is recommended for patients with viremic hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis regardless of levels of viremia or liver enzymes. However, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is not an antiviral treatment criterion in the U.S. HBV treatment guidelines, though prior studies have reported improved survival with antiviral treatment in HBV-related HCC. To inform guidelines, we estimated antiviral treatment rates and their association with survival and HCC recurrence rates in HBV-related HCC. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2006 and 2024 that reported antiviral treatment, survival, and/or HCC recurrence rates in adults with HBV-related HCC, following PRISMA guidelines. Random-effects models pooled study estimates. Of the initial 4556 studies, 178 underwent full-text review, and 78 (68,243 patients) were analysed. The pooled antiviral treatment rate (52 studies, 41,345 patients) was 53.1%. In studies reporting pre-HCC antiviral initiation, 17.2% of HBV-related HCC patients received therapy before diagnosis. Treated (vs untreated) patients had higher 3- and 5-year OS (80.4% vs. 46.8%, both p < 0.01). Five-year OS was 78.0% vs. 56.4% in inactive HCC (p < 0.01) and 48.2% vs. 22.6% in active HCC (p = 0.14). Antiviral therapy remained independently associated with improved 5-year OS in multivariable meta-regression. There was no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates. Antiviral therapy is associated with improved long-term survival but remains underutilized in HBV-related HCC. These findings highlight a critical gap in care and underscore the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in patients with HBV-related HCC.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 78 studies involving 68,243 patients assesses the role of antiviral therapy in improving survival outcomes for individuals with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The review finds that antiviral treatment is associated with higher 3- and 5-year overall survival rates compared to untreated patients. However, antiviral therapy is not currently a standard treatment criterion for HCC in the U.S., and its use remains underreported. The study highlights a critical gap in care and underscores the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in HBV-related HCC. Despite these findings, there is no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates between treated and untreated groups, suggesting further research is needed to understand the full impact of antiviral therapy in this context.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 抗病毒药物 疗法在 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患者中的全球利用不足及其对生存结果的影响。核心问题是 抗病毒药物 疗法是否可以提高 HBV 相关 HCC 的生存率以及其在不同人群中的使用情况如何比较。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 2006 年至 2024 年间发表的涉及 68,243 名患者的 78 项研究进行的系统分析和荟萃分析。这些研究是根据 PRISMA 指南选择的,并使用随机效应模型来汇总研究估计值。该综述纳入了报告 抗病毒药物 治疗、患有 HBV 相关 HCC 的成人患者的生存率和/或 HCC 复发率的研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 抗病毒药物 核苷(酸)类似物治疗可改善 HBV 相关 HCC 的长期生存率。与未经治疗的患者相比,接受治疗的患者具有更高的 3 年和 5 年总生存 (OS) 率。然而,抗病毒药物 疗法目前在美国还不是 HCC 的 治疗 标准,其在临床实践中的使用情况仍然报道不足。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 接受治疗和未接受治疗的患者之间的 HCC 复发率没有显着差异。此外,该审查强调了护理方面的一个关键差距,因为 抗病毒药物 疗法尽管具有潜在的益处,但尚未得到充分利用。证据还表明,抗病毒药物 治疗与生存之间的关联可能因 HCC 的活动性而异。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了改善患者的治疗效果,HBV 相关 HCC 患者需要更早、更一致地开始 抗病毒药物。研究结果强调了修订现行 治疗 指南的重要性,将 抗病毒药物 疗法纳入治疗 HBV 相关 HCC 的标准,特别是在目前尚未充分利用的人群中。

abstract_zh: 使用核苷(酸)类似物进行抗病毒药物治疗被推荐用于所有具有病毒血症的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关肝硬化的患者,无论其病毒载量或肝酶水平如何。然而,肝细胞癌(HCC)并不是美国HBV 治疗指南中的治疗标准。尽管之前的研究报告指出,在HBV相关HCC患者中,抗病毒药物治疗与改善生存率相关,但目前仍缺乏明确的指南。为了指导指南制定,我们估计了抗病毒药物治疗率及其与生存率和HCC复发率之间的关联。我们按照PRISMA指南,对2006年至2024年间发表的、报告了HBV相关HCC成人患者抗病毒药物治疗率、生存率和/或HCC复发率的研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。使用随机效应模型汇总研究估计值。初始共有4556项研究,其中178项进行了全文审查,最终分析了78项(共68,243名患者)。汇总的抗病毒药物治疗率(52项研究,41,345名患者)为53.1%。在报告了HCC前抗病毒药物治疗启动的研究中,17.2%的HBV相关HCC患者在HCC发生前接受了治疗。接受治疗(与未接受治疗相比)的患者3年和5年总生存率(OS)更高(80.4% vs. 46.8%,两者p < 0.01)。在非活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为78.0% vs. 56.4%(p < 0.01),而在活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为48.2% vs. 22.6%(p = 0.14)。在多变量荟萃回归分析中,抗病毒药物治疗仍与改善5年OS独立相关。HCC复发率没有显著差异。抗病毒药物治疗与改善长期生存率相关,但在HBV相关HCC中仍被低估使用。这些发现突显了护理中的关键差距,并强调了在HBV相关HCC患者中更早和更一致地启动抗病毒药物治疗的必要性。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 抗病毒药物 疗法在 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患者中的全球利用不足及其对生存结果的影响。核心问题是 抗病毒药物 疗法是否可以提高 HBV 相关 HCC 的生存率以及其在不同人群中的使用情况如何比较。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 2006 年至 2024 年间发表的涉及 68,243 名患者的 78 项研究进行的系统分析和荟萃分析。这些研究是根据 PRISMA 指南选择的,并使用随机效应模型来汇总研究估计值。该综述纳入了报告 抗病毒药物 治疗、患有 HBV 相关 HCC 的成人患者的生存率和/或 HCC 复发率的研究。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 抗病毒药物 核苷(酸)类似物治疗可改善 HBV 相关 HCC 的长期生存率。与未经治疗的患者相比,接受治疗的患者具有更高的 3 年和 5 年总生存 (OS) 率。然而,抗病毒药物 疗法目前在美国还不是 HCC 的 治疗 标准,其在临床实践中的使用情况仍然报道不足。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 接受治疗和未接受治疗的患者之间的 HCC 复发率没有显着差异。此外,该审查强调了护理方面的一个关键差距,因为 抗病毒药物 疗法尽管具有潜在的益处,但尚未得到充分利用。证据还表明,抗病毒药物 治疗与生存之间的关联可能因 HCC 的活动性而异。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了改善患者的治疗效果,HBV 相关 HCC 患者需要更早、更一致地开始 抗病毒药物。研究结果强调了修订现行 治疗 指南的重要性,将 抗病毒药物 疗法纳入治疗 HBV 相关 HCC 的标准,特别是在目前尚未充分利用的人群中。

title: Safety, Tolerability and Antiviral Activity of GST-HG131 in Chronic Hepatitis B: A Randomized, Double-Blind Phase IIa Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden. Current therapies rarely achieve a functional cure due to low rates of HBsAg clearance, the persistence of the viral replication template-covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA)-and the need for lifelong treatment. GST-HG131 is a first-in-class, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of PAPD5/7, key host factors involved in HBV mRNA stabilization and HBsAg production. We evaluated the safety, tolerability and antiviral activity of GST-HG131 in patients with CHB receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NUC) therapy in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study. METHODS: This double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study evaluated the efficacy and safety of GST-HG131 in 45 CHB patients. Cohorts 1 and 2 (n = 10 each; 8 active, 2 placebo) received 30 mg or 60 mg BID for 28 days, respectively. Cohort 3 (n = 25; 20 active, five placebo) received 30 mg BID for 12 weeks. All participants were on nucleos(t)ide analog monotherapy for more than 6 months, with HBsAg between 100 and 1500 IU/mL, and serum ALT below 1× ULN. RESULTS: At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were -0.65 log10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28-day group and -0.53 log10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28-day group. The 30 mg BID 12-week group showed a greater reduction of -0.89 log10 IU/mL at the end of treatment versus placebo (p 50% reduction in HBsAg with a maximum decrease of 1.64 log10 IU/mL. Notably, 76.5% of patients in the 12-week group achieved HBsAg below 100 IU/mL. Rebounds in HBsAg were observed following treatment discontinuation. GST-HG131 was well tolerated, with no dose-related toxicity or emerging safety concerns across all cohorts. CONCLUSION: GST-HG131, a first-in-class oral PAPD5/7 inhibitor, demonstrated favourable safety and significant HBsAg reduction in patients with CHB. The greatest antiviral activity was observed after 12 weeks of treatment, supporting further clinical development of GST-HG131 as a component of functional cure strategies for CHB. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06263959.

title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of the PD-1 Inhibitor Cetrelimab in Chronic Hepatitis B.
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-induced T-cell exhaustion may be reversed using a programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) inhibitor such as cetrelimab, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody targeting PD-1. To evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose (i.e., a dose lower than that used in oncology) cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virologically suppressed (VS) on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog (NA). Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation study of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, and not to any safety concern, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their NA treatment to avoid HBV reactivation. Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy (RO) and safety were collected over 24 weeks. Eleven participants were enrolled and randomized, eight to cetrelimab and three to placebo and all 11 completed the study. Mean cetrelimab half-life was 16.3 days with median time to maximum cetrelimab concentration 10.4 days post-dose. Near-maximal RO was achieved 6 h post-dose which waned over time. There were no clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in VS participants with CHB was safe and well tolerated. There was no change in HBV biomarkers and further development of cetrelimab for HBV was abandoned. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05242445; EudraCT Number: 2021-004857-21.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B virologically suppressed on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation trial of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their nucleos(t)ide analog treatment to avoid HBV reactivation.
analysis.methods: The study collected serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy and safety data over 24 weeks. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab was administered subcutaneously to participants with chronic hepatitis B virologically suppressed on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog.
analysis.main_results: No clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values, including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone, were observed. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that a single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in virologically suppressed participants with chronic hepatitis B was safe and well tolerated. They also noted that there was no change in HBV biomarkers, leading to the abandonment of further development of cetrelimab for HBV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that cetrelimab may not be effective in altering HBV biomarkers in virologically suppressed participants with chronic hepatitis B, which has implications for the development of PD-1 inhibitors as therapeutic agents for HBV.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a small sample size of 11 participants, with only eight receiving cetrelimab. The evidence is limited by the lack of a comparator group and the short duration of the study, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the safety, activity, and pharmacokinetics of cetrelimab, a PD-1 inhibitor, in participants with chronic hepatitis B who were virologically suppressed on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog. The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-dose escalation trial, with only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) executed. Participants continued their nucleos(t)ide analog treatment to prevent HBV reactivation. The study collected data on cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy, and safety over 24 weeks. No clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or adverse events were observed, leading to the conclusion that cetrelimab was safe and well tolerated but showed no effect on HBV markers. The findings suggest that cetrelimab may not be effective for HBV treatment, resulting in the abandonment of its further development. The study's small sample size and short duration limit the confidence in the results, and the evidence strength is moderate.

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中 PD-1 抑制剂 Cetrelimab 的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照研究。
source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-induced T-cell exhaustion may be reversed using a programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) inhibitor such as cetrelimab, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody targeting PD-1. To evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose (i.e., a dose lower than that used in oncology) cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virologically suppressed (VS) on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog (NA). Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation study of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, and not to any safety concern, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their NA treatment to avoid HBV reactivation. Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy (RO) and safety were collected over 24 weeks. Eleven participants were enrolled and randomized, eight to cetrelimab and three to placebo and all 11 completed the study. Mean cetrelimab half-life was 16.3 days with median time to maximum cetrelimab concentration 10.4 days post-dose. Near-maximal RO was achieved 6 h post-dose which waned over time. There were no clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in VS participants with CHB was safe and well tolerated. There was no change in HBV biomarkers and further development of cetrelimab for HBV was abandoned. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05242445; EudraCT Number: 2021-004857-21.

title: Finite Versus Indefinite Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy in HBeAg‐Negative Chronic Hepatitis B: Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Trials.
abstract: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I 2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

title_zh: HBeAg阴性慢性乙型肝炎中有限与无限核苷(酸)类似物治疗的对比:随机试验的荟萃分析
source_body_en: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I 2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

title: Chronic Hepatitis B in the United States: Current Landscape, Unmet Needs and Future Directions
abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection represents a major public health challenge in the US, with substantial unmet needs related to timely diagnosis, treatment, monitoring and disease management. This narrative review explores the CHB landscape in the US, including gaps in patient care, the evolving therapeutic landscape, the clinical utility of serological biomarkers to improve outcomes and the experiences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB). Hepatitis B remains underdiagnosed and undertreated in the US, and current efforts are insufficient to meet the associated World Health Organization 2030 elimination targets. Latest guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America, representing a North American perspective, signify a shift towards expanded treatment eligibility criteria and shared decision‐making. Nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) are the current standard of care in the US, but functional cure is rarely achieved with NAs alone. Novel finite therapies targeting functional cure, such as antisense oligonucleotides, small interfering RNAs, immune modulators and combination or sequential regimens, are under investigation. Because of the unpredictable, complex nature of CHB, biomarkers such as quantitative hepatitis B surface antigen offer prognostic value for treatment decisions and could help guide individualised CHB management. PLWHB experience psychological impacts and health‐related concerns, including fear of transmission and hepatitis B virus‐related complications. Opportunities for improvement of CHB management include increased screening and linkage to care, development of more treatments targeting functional cure, adoption of serological biomarkers to inform treatment decisions and prioritising the lived experiences and preferences of PLWHB.

analysis.summary_en: This review highlights the challenges of managing chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the United States, emphasizing the need for improved diagnosis, treatment, and patient care. It outlines the current standard of care, which involves nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs), but notes that these rarely achieve a functional cure. The review identifies gaps in the management of CHB, including the lack of effective therapies and the underutilization of serological biomarkers. It also underscores the importance of incorporating the lived experiences and preferences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB) into treatment decisions. The review calls for expanded treatment eligibility criteria and shared decision-making, as reflected in the latest guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America. Despite these efforts, current strategies are insufficient to meet the World Health Organization's 2030 elimination targets, indicating a need for further research and innovation in CHB management.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在美国,乙型肝炎的诊断和治疗仍然不足,目前的努力不足以实现世界卫生组织相关的 2030 年消除目标。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 由于慢性乙型肝炎的不可预测性和复杂性,定量乙型肝炎表面抗原等生物标志物可为 治疗 决策提供预后价值,并有助于指导个体化慢性乙型肝炎管理。

title: Transplantation of Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Positive or Viremic Kidneys: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis examines the evidence related to the use of HBV positive kidneys into non-viremic kidney transplant recipients (KTRs). METHODS: We searched PubMed and Embase through November 2025 and identified studies of recipients of hepatitis B surface antigen positive (HBsAg+) or viremic kidneys. Studies with a comparison group of KTRs of HBV negative kidneys that reported on patient and allograft survivals were included in the meta-analysis. The risk ratios (RR) for patient and allograft survivals were pooled to obtain the estimate and 95% confidence interval, at 1-, 3-, and 5-years post-transplant. Viral transmission including HBsAg development, HBV viremia, or hepatitis was also reviewed. RESULTS: Eleven studies were included in the systematic review and 6 in the meta-analysis. They included 638 KTRs of HBV positive kidneys and 2800 recipients of HBsAg negative non viremic kidneys. At 1, 3, and 5 years, the RR of allograft survival was not statistically different between the 2 groups and was 1 [0.98-1.01], 1.01 [0.98-1.04], and 1.00 [0.91-1.09] respectively. Similarly, the RR of patient survival was comparable between the 2 groups. The rate of HBV transmission was low (4.94%), especially when prophylaxis was used and when recipients were immune pre transplant. CONCLUSION: Kidneys from HBV infected donors confer similar patient and allograft survival than those from HBV negative donors. They may be used to expand the donor pool, in immune KTRs and with appropriate prophylaxis, in light of this emerging evidence of safety with very low reported rates of transmission.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性或病毒血症肾脏移植:系统评价和荟萃分析。
source_body_en: PURPOSE: This systematic review and meta-analysis examines the evidence related to the use of HBV positive kidneys into non-viremic kidney transplant recipients (KTRs). Studies with a comparison group of KTRs of HBV negative kidneys that reported on patient and allograft survivals were included in the meta-analysis. The risk ratios (RR) for patient and allograft survivals were pooled to obtain the estimate and 95% confidence interval, at 1-, 3-, and 5-years post-transplant. Viral transmission including HBsAg development, HBV viremia, or hepatitis was also reviewed. RESULTS: Eleven studies were included in the systematic review and 6 in the meta-analysis. They included 638 KTRs of HBV positive kidneys and 2800 recipients of HBsAg negative non viremic kidneys. At 1, 3, and 5 years, the RR of allograft survival was not statistically different between the 2 groups and was 1 [0.98-1.01], 1.01 [0.98-1.04], and 1.00 [0.91-1.09] respectively. Similarly, the RR of patient survival was comparable between the 2 groups. The rate of HBV transmission was low (4.94%), especially when prophylaxis was used and when recipients were immune pre transplant. CONCLUSION: Kidneys from HBV infected donors confer similar patient and allograft survival than those from HBV negative donors. They may be used to expand the donor pool, in immune KTRs and with appropriate prophylaxis, in light of this emerging evidence of safety with very low reported rates of transmission.

title: Similar Long-Term Incidence of Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Chronic Hepatitis B Initiating Entecavir Versus Tenofovir Alafenamide: A REAL-B Study.
abstract: Data on potential differences in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence between entecavir (ETV) and tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients are limited. This retrospective multinational study included treatment-naïve adults with CHB without a history of HCC who initiated ETV or TAF therapy since 2016 at 23 centres in 4 countries. Baseline characteristics were balanced using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) and propensity score matching (PSM). HCC incidence and the association between antiviral regimen and HCC were analysed using competing-risk analysis. A total of 1437 patients (710 ETV, 727 TAF) were included, with similar mean follow-up durations (55.5 ± 29.8 vs. 58.0 ± 25.5 months; p = 0.077). ETV-treated patients were older, more frequently male, and more likely to have cirrhosis. After IPTW, both groups had balanced characteristics (all standardised differences < 0.1). After IPTW adjustment, during follow-up, 23 patients on ETV and 20 on TAF developed HCC, with incidence rates of 0.67 and 0.65 per 100 person-years, respectively (p = 0.853). There was no statistically significant difference in HCC risk between the groups (SHR: 1.09; 95% CI: 0.44-2.65; p = 0.851), with consistent findings across subgroups by age, sex, cirrhosis, hepatic steatosis, HBeAg, baseline liver enzymes, HBV DNA levels, diabetes mellitus and in sensitivity analysis using PSM. In this real-world multinational study of treatment-naïve CHB patients, HCC incidence did not significantly differ between ETV and TAF groups, suggesting therapeutic selection should consider cost and patient-specific factors.

abstract_zh: 关于恩替卡韦(ETV)和替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中对肝细胞癌(HCC)发病率潜在差异的数据有限。本回顾性多国研究纳入了2016年以来在4个国家的23个中心开始接受ETV或TAF治疗的、无HCC病史且未接受过抗病毒药物治疗的CHB成人患者。使用逆概率加权(IPTW)和倾向评分匹配(PSM)方法平衡基线特征。采用竞争风险分析方法分析HCC发病率及抗病毒治疗方案与HCC之间的关联。共纳入1437名患者(ETV组710名,TAF组727名),其平均随访时间相似(ETV组55.5 ± 29.8个月 vs. TAF组58.0 ± 25.5个月;p = 0.077)。接受ETV治疗的患者年龄更大,男性比例更高,且更可能患有肝硬化。在IPTW调整后,两组患者的特征趋于平衡(所有标准化差异均<0.1)。调整后随访期间,ETV组有23例患者和TAF组有20例患者发展为HCC,其HCC发病率分别为每100人年0.67和0.65(p = 0.853)。两组之间HCC风险无统计学显著差异(SHR:1.09;95% CI:0.44-2.65;p = 0.851),且在按年龄、性别、肝硬化、脂肪肝、HBeAg状态、基线肝酶水平、HBV DNA水平、糖尿病等亚组分析以及使用PSM进行敏感性分析中结果一致。在这一真实世界多国研究中,对于未接受过抗病毒治疗的CHB患者,ETV和TAF组的HCC发病率无显著差异,提示治疗选择应考虑成本和患者个体因素。

title: Hepatitis B and D: Interferon‐Based Therapy—For Clinical Trials or Standard of Care—Back to the Future?
abstract: ABSTRACT Interferon (IFN) has historically played a major role in chronic viral hepatitis B and D management over the last three decades. Widening utilisation of nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) for hepatitis B viral suppression, which have a better side‐effect profile, alongside the recent licensing of bulevirtide for treatment of hepatitis D, means that its clinical use has further declined. Pegylated‐interferon alpha (peg‐IFNα) treatment is suboptimal with poor tolerability and achieves durable clearance of hepatitis B and D in only a limited number of patients. Nevertheless, its use in hepatitis B has significantly increased the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to those on NUCs alone. Evidence has shown that peg‐IFNα is also associated with overall improved long‐term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for the many whose hepatitis D viral load rebounds after discontinuation. Clinical trials have recently focused on peg‐IFNα in combination with novel antiviral therapies in the goal for finite cure in hepatitis B and D. This article focuses on recent research advances, examining if peg‐IFNα treatment may still play an important role in hepatitis B and D treatment.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of interferon-based therapy in the treatment of hepatitis B and D, specifically examining its clinical use, effectiveness, and potential for future applications. The central question is whether pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα) treatment may still play an important role in managing these infections.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It includes a general overview of the topic and highlights recent clinical trials and research advances.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that peg-IFNα is associated with improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for patients whose viral load rebounds after treatment. It also notes that peg-IFNα has been shown to increase the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) alone.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that peg-IFNα treatment is suboptimal due to poor tolerability and limited durable clearance of hepatitis B and D. It also points out that the use of NUCs has increased, and the recent licensing of bulevirtide for hepatitis D has further reduced the clinical use of peg-IFNα.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on combining peg-IFNα with novel antiviral therapies to achieve a finite cure for hepatitis B and D. It also implies that there is a need for further investigation into the long-term benefits and risks of peg-IFNα treatment.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the role of interferon-based therapy, particularly pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα), in the treatment of hepatitis B and D. It highlights that while peg-IFNα has been associated with improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D and increased HBsAg loss in hepatitis B compared to nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) alone, its use has declined due to poor tolerability and limited durable clearance. The review also notes the recent licensing of bulevirtide for hepatitis D and the increasing use of NUCs. It suggests that future research should explore combining peg-IFNα with novel antiviral therapies to achieve a finite cure for these infections.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注基于干扰素的治疗在乙型和丁型肝炎 治疗 中的作用,特别检查其临床用途、有效性和未来应用的潜力。核心问题是聚乙二醇化干扰素 α (peg-IFNα) 治疗 是否仍可能在控制这些感染中发挥重要作用。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对现有文献的叙述性综合,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或荟萃分析。它包括对该主题的总体概述,并重点介绍了最近的临床试验和研究进展。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述的结论是,peg-IFNα 与改善慢性丁型肝炎的长期临床结果相关,即使对于 治疗 后病毒载量反弹的患者也是如此。它还指出,与单独使用核苷/核苷酸类似物 (NUC) 相比,peg-IFNα 已被证明可以增加乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 消失的患者数量。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调,peg-IFNα 治疗 由于对乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的耐受性差且持久清除有限,因此不是最理想的。它还指出,NUC 的使用有所增加,而近期 bulevirtide 用于丁型肝炎的许可进一步减少了 peg-IFNα 的临床使用。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议,未来的研究应侧重于将peg-IFNα与新型抗病毒药物疗法相结合,以实现乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的有限治愈。这也意味着需要进一步研究peg-IFNα 治疗的长期获益和风险。

abstract_zh: 摘要 过去三十年来,干扰素 (IFN) 在慢性病毒性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的治疗中发挥了重要作用。核苷/核苷酸类似物(NUC)在抑制乙型肝炎病毒方面的广泛应用,其副作用较小,加上最近获得了用于丁型肝炎 治疗 的 bulevirtide 许可,意味着其临床使用进一步下降。聚乙二醇化干扰素α (peg-IFNα) 治疗 效果欠佳,耐受性较差,仅在有限数量的患者中实现了乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的持久清除。尽管如此,与单独使用 NUC 的患者相比,其在乙型肝炎中的使用显着增加了实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 消失的患者数量。有证据表明,peg-IFNα 还与慢性丁型肝炎的长期临床结局的整体改善相关,即使对于许多丁型肝炎病毒载量在停药后反弹的人来说也是如此。最近的临床试验重点关注 peg-IFNα 与新型 抗病毒药物 疗法的联合治疗,以实现乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的有限治愈。本文重点介绍最新的研究进展,探讨 peg-IFNα 治疗 是否仍可能在乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎 治疗 中发挥重要作用。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注基于干扰素的治疗在乙型和丁型肝炎 治疗 中的作用,特别检查其临床用途、有效性和未来应用的潜力。核心问题是聚乙二醇化干扰素 α (peg-IFNα) 治疗 是否仍可能在控制这些感染中发挥重要作用。

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议,未来的研究应侧重于将peg-IFNα与新型抗病毒药物疗法相结合,以实现乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的有限治愈。这也意味着需要进一步研究peg-IFNα 治疗的长期获益和风险。

title: A comparative viral load evaluation for human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B virus and hepatitis C virus of the Roche cobas 5800, Abbott Alinity m and Hologic Panther
abstract: Abstract Background and Objectives Viral load (VL) quantification for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) is essential for clinical monitoring, treatment response assessment and post‐donation interpretation. With the introduction of automated molecular platforms, comparative evaluations are required to assess inter‐platform agreement, bias and precision across the quantitative VL range. Materials and Methods A comparative study was conducted using 280 plasma samples from blood donors. VL measurements were performed using the Roche cobas 5800 system, Abbott Alinity m system and the relevant Aptima quantitative assays on the Hologic Panther system. Agreement between platforms was assessed using Deming regression, Passing–Bablok regression, Lin's concordance correlation coefficient and Bland–Altman analyses. Precision was evaluated using repeatability and reproducibility testing using coefficients of variation (CVs). Differences in mean VL measurements were assessed with one‐way analysis of variance (ANOVA). Results The platforms showed comparable log 10 VL and acceptable precision across all targets. Deming regression identified constant bias in comparisons and proportional bias in one HCV comparison. Passing–Bablok regression and Lin's concordance correlation coefficient further showed that agreement differed. ANOVA showed no significant differences for HBV and HCV, while HIV showed a significant difference in VL values. Conclusion The platforms demonstrated acceptable precision for quantitative HIV, HBV and HCV VL testing. Roche cobas 5800 system showed low CVs in several repeatability comparisons, while within‐laboratory reproducibility showed variability for HBV and HIV. Agreement analyses identified constant bias, proportional bias and variability in platform comparisons.

title: The present and future of HIV and viral hepatitis co-infection.
abstract: HIV and hepatitis virus co-infection remains a major global health challenge, driven by shared transmission routes, populations with overlapping modes of acquisition, and potentially compounded disease progression. Co-infections of HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) remain prevalent, particularly among people who live in endemic areas, key populations, people who inject drugs, men who have sex with men, and migrants from endemic regions. Antiretroviral therapy is shifting towards regimens without HBV activity, increasing the risk for HBV infection or reactivation in some individuals. Although direct-acting antivirals have reduced active HCV infection considerably in many high-income settings, residual disease burden, reinfections, and inequitable access to treatment persist. Hepatitis delta virus continues to represent a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection among individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with insufficient global surveillance data. Acute hepatitis A and E increasingly affect people with HIV, presenting both as outbreak-related and sporadic cases, particularly in the context of suboptimal vaccination coverage. Contemporary management emphasises systematic screening, vaccination, integrated antiviral strategies, and public health interventions to reduce liver-related morbidity and mortality in people with HIV.

Antiretroviral therapy is shifting towards regimens without HBV activity, increasing the risk for HBV infection or reactivation in some individuals. Although direct-acting antivirals have reduced active HCV infection considerably in many high-income settings, residual disease burden, reinfections, and inequitable access to treatment persist. Hepatitis delta virus continues to represent a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection among individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with insufficient global surveillance data. Acute hepatitis A and E increasingly affect people with HIV, presenting both as outbreak-related and sporadic cases, particularly in the context of suboptimal vaccination coverage. Contemporary management emphasises systematic screening, vaccination, integrated antiviral strategies, and public health interventions to reduce liver-related morbidity and mortality in people with HIV.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the challenges and implications of hepatitis B virus (HBV) co-infection with HIV. It highlights the global health burden of HBV, particularly in populations with overlapping transmission routes. The evidence suggests that antiretroviral therapy is increasingly avoiding HBV activity, which may increase the risk of HBV infection or reactivation. Despite progress in treating hepatitis C virus (HCV) with direct-acting antivirals, challenges such as residual disease burden, reinfections, and treatment access remain. Additionally, hepatitis delta virus (HDV) is noted as a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection in individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with limited global surveillance data. The review emphasizes the need for systematic screening, vaccination, and integrated antiviral strategies to reduce liver-related morbidity and mortality in people living with HIV.

abstract_zh: HIV与肝炎病毒共感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其原因包括共同的传播途径、具有重叠获得方式的人群以及可能加剧的疾病进展。HIV与乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)的共感染仍然普遍,尤其是在流行区生活的人群、关键人群、注射毒品者、男男性行为者以及来自流行区的移民中。抗逆转录病毒治疗正朝着不含HBV活性的方案转变,这使得某些个体感染或重新激活HBV的风险增加。尽管直接作用抗病毒药物(DAAs)在许多高收入地区显著降低了HCV的活动性感染,但残留的疾病负担、再感染以及对治疗的不平等获取仍然存在。肝炎delta病毒(HDV)继续作为HIV-HBV共感染个体中一种严重但未被充分诊断的共感染存在,且全球关于其诊断的数据仍不充分。急性甲型肝炎和戊型肝炎越来越多地影响HIV感染者,表现为与HIV相关的病例和散发病例,特别是在血清学监测覆盖率不足的背景下。当代管理强调系统性筛查、血清学监测、整合治疗策略以及公共卫生干预措施,以减少HIV感染者与肝炎相关的发病率和死亡率。

title: Anti‐Viral Treatment Eligibility and Treatment Uptake Among People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Australia: The REACH ‐B Study
abstract: ABSTRACT Treatment indication for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) varies across clinical guidelines. This study evaluated treatment eligibility and uptake in a large Australian cohort of people with CHB. The REACH‐B study recruited people with CHB managed through a national network of healthcare services. Participants were categorised into three groups: (1) receiving antiviral therapy; (2) untreated despite eligibility; (3) untreated and ineligible. Treatment eligibility was determined using Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) criteria, and by international clinical guidelines. Among 3648 participants (56% male; median age 48 years; 49% born in North‐East or South‐East Asia; 27% First Nations Australians), 14% were HBeAg positive and 7% had cirrhosis. Overall, 47% ( n = 1666) were on antiviral therapy, 45% ( n = 1573) were untreated and ineligible and 7% ( n = 251) were untreated despite eligibility based on Australian PBS criteria. In adjusted analysis, the likelihood of remaining untreated despite eligibility was higher among women (aOR 1.59, 95% CI 1.34, 1.88) and younger participants (age 41–60 vs. > 60 years: aOR 1.51, 95% CI 1.01–2.28; ≤ 40 vs. > 60 years: aOR 2.65, 95% CI 1.60, 4.40). The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines and ranged 2%–44% based on other guidelines, highlighting the variability across the guidelines. In conclusion, among REACH‐B participants, most eligible individuals receive treatment. Lower treatment uptake among women and younger people despite eligibility partly reflects lower threshold for elevated ALT in women, and clinician determination of non‐CHB related ALT elevation. As treatment guidelines evolve and eligibility criteria broaden, monitoring treatment patterns is important.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate treatment eligibility and uptake among people with chronic hepatitis B in Australia, highlighting the variability in treatment criteria across different guidelines.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The REACH‐B study recruited people with chronic hepatitis B managed through a national network of healthcare services. Participants were categorised into three groups: (1) receiving antiviral therapy; (2) untreated despite eligibility; (3) untreated and ineligible. Among 3648 participants (56% male; median age 48 years; 49% born in North‐East or South‐East Asia; 27% First Nations Australians), 14% were HBeAg positive and 7% had cirrhosis.
analysis_en.methods: Treatment eligibility was determined using Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) criteria and international clinical guidelines. Participants were categorised into three groups based on their treatment status and eligibility.
analysis_en.main_results: Overall, 47% (n = 1666) were on antiviral therapy, 45% (n = 1573) were untreated and ineligible, and 7% (n = 251) were untreated despite eligibility based on Australian PBS criteria. The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines, ranging from 2%–44% based on other guidelines.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the variability in treatment eligibility criteria across different guidelines and the impact of these differences on treatment uptake among eligible individuals.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the disparities in treatment uptake among eligible individuals, which can inform targeted interventions to improve treatment adherence and outcomes in specific demographic groups.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's findings are based on a large cohort, but the interpretation of treatment eligibility is influenced by varying guidelines, which may limit the generalisability of the results. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on observational data and the potential for guideline variability to affect outcomes.

title_zh: 澳大利亚 治疗 患者的抗病毒 治疗 资格和 治疗 的使用情况:REACH ‐B 研究
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Treatment indication for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) varies across clinical guidelines. This study evaluated treatment eligibility and uptake in a large Australian cohort of people with CHB. The REACH‐B study recruited people with CHB managed through a national network of healthcare services. Participants were categorised into three groups: (1) receiving antiviral therapy; (2) untreated despite eligibility; (3) untreated and ineligible. Treatment eligibility was determined using Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) criteria, and by international clinical guidelines. Among 3648 participants (56% male; median age 48 years; 49% born in North‐East or South‐East Asia; 27% First Nations Australians), 14% were HBeAg positive and 7% had cirrhosis. Overall, 47% ( n = 1666) were on antiviral therapy, 45% ( n = 1573) were untreated and ineligible and 7% ( n = 251) were untreated despite eligibility based on Australian PBS criteria. In adjusted analysis, the likelihood of remaining untreated despite eligibility was higher among women (aOR 1.59, 95% CI 1.34, 1.88) and younger participants (age 41–60 vs. > 60 years: aOR 1.51, 95% CI 1.01–2.28; ≤ 40 vs. > 60 years: aOR 2.65, 95% CI 1.60, 4.40). The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines and ranged 2%–44% based on other guidelines, highlighting the variability across the guidelines. In conclusion, among REACH‐B participants, most eligible individuals receive treatment. Lower treatment uptake among women and younger people despite eligibility partly reflects lower threshold for elevated ALT in women, and clinician determination of non‐CHB related ALT elevation. As treatment guidelines evolve and eligibility criteria broaden, monitoring treatment patterns is important.

title: Prospective Evaluation of Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation in Cancer Patients Receiving Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
abstract: Data on hepatitis B virus reactivation (HBVr) during tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy remain limited. We prospectively enrolled patients with chronic or resolved HBV receiving TKIs for lung cancer or chronic myeloid leukemia at one Taiwanese center (January 2023-March 2025). HBV DNA and liver enzymes were monitored 12-weekly and HBsAg 24-weekly. HBVr was defined by AASLD criteria, with APASL and EASL definitions applied secondarily. Among 79 patients (20 HBsAg-positive, 59 resolved HBV), none received antiviral prophylaxis. Median follow-up was 42 weeks (IQR, 19-65). HBVr occurred in 7 (8.9%; 95% CI, 4.4%-17.2%): 5 HBsAg-positive (25.0%; 95% CI, 11.2%-46.9%), and 2 with resolved HBV (3.4%; 95% CI, 0.9%-11.5%). APASL and EASL definitions yielded 30.0% and 35.0% in HBsAg-positive patients, with no additional events in resolved HBV. No HBVr-associated hepatitis flare meeting the study definition was observed, although transient flares between assessments could not be excluded and deterioration in one fatal case was attributed clinically to sepsis. Median HBVr detection time was 19 weeks (IQR, 14-30). Week-48 Kaplan-Meier HBVr incidence was 37.5% (95% CI, 17.0%-69.5%) in HBsAg-positive and 5.6% (95% CI, 1.4%-21.2%) in resolved HBV (log-rank p < 0.001); Aalen-Johansen estimates were 28.3% (95% CI, 9.5%-50.9%) and 4.3% (95% CI, 0.8%-13.2%), respectively. In exploratory Firth-corrected regression, HBsAg positivity was associated with HBVr (HR, 6.95; 95% CI, 1.60-40.19), while osimertinib exposure was not. HBVr was common among HBsAg-positive patients and less common but not negligible among those with resolved HBV receiving TKIs.

title: Sustained HBsAg Loss and Marked Reversal of Liver Cirrhosis in a Patient with Antiviral-Resistant Chronic Hepatitis B: A Case Report with 13-Year Follow-up
abstract: Abstract Background Achieving sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss and reversing established cirrhosis is considered extremely challenging, especially in patients with prior antiviral resistance. We report a case of marked reversal of liver cirrhosis and sustained HBsAg loss in a patient with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who previously failed standard antiviral therapy. Case Presentation A 60-year-old male patient was diagnosed with CHB in 2006 and developed cirrhosis after 6 years of standard antiviral therapy at a top-tier hospital. In February 2012, his liver stiffness (FibroScan) was 19.9 kPa, with HBV DNA at 1.47×10^7 IU/ml. He subsequently received combined Chinese-Western medicine ("Neo-Chinese Medicine") treatment. After 7 years and 2 months of treatment, his liver function normalized, HBV DNA became undetectable, and FibroScan decreased to 5.1 kPa. Notably, the patient achieved HBsAg loss and Pre-S1 antigen negativity. All medications were discontinued in April 2019. By November 2020, despite the patient developing hyperlipidemia and steatohepatitis due to lifestyle factors, imaging and elastography confirmed a marked reversal of cirrhosis (FibroScan: 6.2 kPa, normal portal vein diameter of 12 mm) without disease progression. Long-term follow-up up to 2025 consistently showed sustained HBsAg negativity (< 0.05 IU/ml) and undetectable highly sensitive HBV DNA. Conclusion This case demonstrates that Neo-Chinese Medicine can achieve marked reversal of cirrhosis and sustained functional cure in patients with antiviral-resistant CHB. The durability of these outcomes after treatment discontinuation suggests a fundamental restoration of the hepatic microenvironment and the depletion of the viral reservoir.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 持续消失并逆转已形成的肝硬化被认为​​极具挑战性,特别是对于既往具有 抗病毒药物 耐药性的患者。该研究旨在报告一名 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者的肝硬化显着逆转和持续 HBsAg 消失的病例,该患者之前标准 抗病毒药物 治疗失败。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一名60岁男性患者于2006年被诊断出慢性乙型肝炎,在一家三甲医院接受标准抗病毒药物治疗6年后发展为肝硬化。该病例随访时间为2012年2月至2020年11月,治疗涉及中西医结合(“新中医”)。
elements_zh.methods: 患者接受中西医结合(“新中医”)治疗治疗。在随访期间监测肝功能、HBV DNA 和肝硬度 (FibroScan)。
elements_zh.main_results: 经过7年零2个月的治疗治疗,患者的肝功能恢复正常,HBV DNA检测不到,FibroScan降至5.1 kPa。值得注意的是,患者的 HBsAg 消失且 Pre-S1 抗原呈阴性。截至 2025 年的长期随访一致显示 HBsAg 持续阴性(< 0.05 IU/ml)和无法检测到的高度敏感的 HBV DNA。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例表明,新中医药可以对抗病毒药物耐药的慢乙肝患者实现显着逆转肝硬化和持续功能性治愈治疗。治疗 停药后这些结果的持久性表明肝脏微环境的根本恢复和病毒 储存宿主 的消耗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,新中医药可能为治疗 抗病毒药物 耐药的 CHB 提供一种有前途的方法,有可能导致持续的 功能性治愈 和逆转肝硬化。这可能对 慢性乙型肝炎 及相关并发症的治疗产生重大影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到 病例报告 设计的限制,无法推广到其他患者。由于缺乏对照组以及缺乏详细的 治疗 方案和结果,因此很难评估新中医疗法的具体贡献。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.main_results: 经过7年零2个月的治疗治疗,患者的肝功能恢复正常,HBV DNA检测不到,FibroScan降至5.1 kPa。值得注意的是,患者的 HBsAg 消失且 Pre-S1 抗原呈阴性。截至 2025 年的长期随访一致显示 HBsAg 持续阴性(< 0.05 IU/ml)和无法检测到的高度敏感的 HBV DNA。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例表明,新中医药可以对抗病毒药物耐药的慢乙肝患者实现显着逆转肝硬化和持续功能性治愈治疗。治疗 停药后这些结果的持久性表明肝脏微环境的根本恢复和病毒 储存宿主 的消耗。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,新中医药可能为治疗 抗病毒药物 耐药的 CHB 提供一种有前途的方法,有可能导致持续的 功能性治愈 和逆转肝硬化。这可能对 慢性乙型肝炎 及相关并发症的治疗产生重大影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到 病例报告 设计的限制,无法推广到其他患者。由于缺乏对照组以及缺乏详细的 治疗 方案和结果,因此很难评估新中医疗法的具体贡献。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

title: Hepatitis B seroprevalence among children aged 0.6-14 years in Jiangsu, China, in 2023-2025.
abstract: China has implemented universal hepatitis B vaccination in all neonates since 2002 and has enhanced prophylaxis against mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) by providing charge-free hepatitis B immunoglobulin in infants of HBV-infected mothers since 2011 and by recommending routine antiviral prophylaxis in HBV-infected mothers with high viral loads since 2020. We aimed to survey the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in children born from 2010 to 2024 in Jiangsu Province, based on convenience sampling in children who visited hospitals. We tested hepatitis B markers in 20,317 children aged 7.9 ± 4.1 years, with 11477 boys and 8840 girls, from 8 cities across Jiangsu during February 2023 to December 2025. Of them, 14 (0.069%, 95% CI: 0.038-0.116) were HBsAg positive. The positive rates of HBsAg in 0.5-<3, 3-<6, 6-<9, 9-<12, and 12-<15 years groups were 0% (0/2520), 0% (0/3858), 0.024% (1/4243), 0.136% (6/4401), and 0.132% (7/5295), respectively (P = .01489). The overall positive rate of antibody against HBsAg was 68.11% (12046/17686), with a decreasing trend over the ages (from 96.17% in 0.5-<3 year children to 48.41% in 12-<15 year children). In HBsAg-negative children, the positive rate of antibody against hepatitis B core antigen was 7.68% (1383/18007), increasing from 4.23% in 0.5-<3 year children to 7.84% in 12-<15 year children (Z = 5.0398, P < .0001). The present study showed that HBsAg prevalence among children in Jiangsu has substantially declined since the implementation of enhanced prevention of HBV perinatal infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to survey the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in children born from 2010 to 2024 in Jiangsu Province, based on convenience sampling in children who visited hospitals. China has implemented universal hepatitis B vaccination in all neonates since 2002 and has enhanced prophylaxis against mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) by providing charge-free hepatitis B immunoglobulin in infants of HBV-infected mothers since 2011 and by recommending routine antiviral prophylaxis in HBV-infected mothers with high viral loads since 2020.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in 8 cities across Jiangsu Province from February 2023 to December 2025. It tested hepatitis B markers in 20,317 children aged 7.9 ± 4.1 years, with 11477 boys and 8840 girls.
analysis.methods: Hepatitis B markers were tested in children who visited hospitals during the study period. The study used convenience sampling and focused on measuring the prevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and antibody against HBsAg and hepatitis B core antigen.
analysis.main_results: Of the 20,317 children tested, 14 (0.069%, 95% CI: 0.038-0.116) were HBsAg positive. The positive rates of HBsAg in the 0.5-<3, 3-<6, 6-<9, 9-<12, and 12-<15 years groups were 0% (0/2520), 0% (0/3858), 0.024% (1/4243), 0.136% (6/4401), and 0.132% (7/5295), respectively (P = .01489). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study showed that HBsAg prevalence among children in Jiangsu has substantially declined since the implementation of enhanced prevention of HBV perinatal infection. This decline highlights the effectiveness of the prevention strategies in reducing HBV transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide evidence of the success of hepatitis B prevention strategies in Jiangsu, which can inform public health policies and surveillance efforts for HBV in other regions with similar interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in children aged 0.6-14 years in Jiangsu, China, from 2023 to 2025. It found that 14 out of 20,317 children were HBsAg positive, with a prevalence rate of 0.069% (95% CI: 0.038-0.116). The prevalence varied across age groups, with the highest rate observed in the 12-<15 years group. The study also noted a decreasing trend in HBsAg positivity with age, from 96.17% in 0.5-<3 year children to 48.41% in 12-<15 year children. In HBsAg-negative children, the positive rate of antibody against hepatitis B core antigen increased from 4.23% to 7.84% across age groups. These results suggest that the enhanced prevention strategies implemented in China have significantly reduced HBV transmission among children. The study's findings can inform public health policies and surveillance efforts for HBV in other regions with similar interventions. However, the use of convenience sampling may introduce selection bias, which limits the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于2023年2月至2025年12月在江苏省8个城市进行,对20317名7.9±4.1岁儿童进行了乙型肝炎标志物检测,其中男孩11477名,女孩8840名。
elements_zh.methods: 对研究期间到访医院的儿童进行了乙型肝炎标志物检测。该研究采用方便抽样,重点测量乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)以及针对HBsAg和乙型肝炎核心抗原的抗体的患病率。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究显示,江苏省儿童乙型肝炎病毒围产期感染强化预防以来,HBsAg 患病率 明显下降。这一下降凸显了预防策略在减少 HBV 传播 方面的有效性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为江苏乙型肝炎预防策略的成功提供了证据,可为其他地区采取类似干预措施的公共卫生政策和 监测 乙型肝炎防治工作提供参考。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to survey the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in children born from 2010 to 2024 in Jiangsu Province, based on convenience sampling in children who visited hospitals. China has implemented universal hepatitis B vaccination in all neonates since 2002 and has enhanced prophylaxis against mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) by providing charge-free hepatitis B immunoglobulin in infants of HBV-infected mothers since 2011 and by recommending routine antiviral prophylaxis in HBV-infected mothers with high viral loads since 2020.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in 8 cities across Jiangsu Province from February 2023 to December 2025. It tested hepatitis B markers in 20,317 children aged 7.9 ± 4.1 years, with 11477 boys and 8840 girls.
analysis_en.methods: Hepatitis B markers were tested in children who visited hospitals during the study period. The study used convenience sampling and focused on measuring the prevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and antibody against HBsAg and hepatitis B core antigen.
analysis_en.main_results: Of the 20,317 children tested, 14 (0.069%, 95% CI: 0.038-0.116) were HBsAg positive. The positive rates of HBsAg in the 0.5-<3, 3-<6, 6-<9, 9-<12, and 12-<15 years groups were 0% (0/2520), 0% (0/3858), 0.024% (1/4243), 0.136% (6/4401), and 0.132% (7/5295), respectively (P = .01489). In HBsAg-negative children, the positive rate of antibody against hepatitis B core antigen was 7.68% (1383/18007), increasing from 4.23% in 0.5-<3 year children to 7.84% in 12-<15 year children (Z = 5.0398, P < .0001).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study showed that HBsAg prevalence among children in Jiangsu has substantially declined since the implementation of enhanced prevention of HBV perinatal infection. This decline highlights the effectiveness of the prevention strategies in reducing HBV transmission.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide evidence of the success of hepatitis B prevention strategies in Jiangsu, which can inform public health policies and surveillance efforts for HBV in other regions with similar interventions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study used convenience sampling, which may introduce selection bias. However, the evidence is strong given the substantial decline in HBsAg prevalence and the statistical significance of the results (P < .0001).

title_zh: 2023-2025 年中国江苏省 0.6-14 岁儿童乙型肝炎 血清流行率。
source_body_en: China has implemented universal hepatitis B vaccination in all neonates since 2002 and has enhanced prophylaxis against mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) by providing charge-free hepatitis B immunoglobulin in infants of HBV-infected mothers since 2011 and by recommending routine antiviral prophylaxis in HBV-infected mothers with high viral loads since 2020. We aimed to survey the seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) in children born from 2010 to 2024 in Jiangsu Province, based on convenience sampling in children who visited hospitals. We tested hepatitis B markers in 20,317 children aged 7.9 ± 4.1 years, with 11477 boys and 8840 girls, from 8 cities across Jiangsu during February 2023 to December 2025. Of them, 14 (0.069%, 95% CI: 0.038-0.116) were HBsAg positive. The positive rates of HBsAg in 0.5-<3, 3-<6, 6-<9, 9-<12, and 12-<15 years groups were 0% (0/2520), 0% (0/3858), 0.024% (1/4243), 0.136% (6/4401), and 0.132% (7/5295), respectively (P = .01489). The overall positive rate of antibody against HBsAg was 68.11% (12046/17686), with a decreasing trend over the ages (from 96.17% in 0.5-<3 year children to 48.41% in 12-<15 year children). In HBsAg-negative children, the positive rate of antibody against hepatitis B core antigen was 7.68% (1383/18007), increasing from 4.23% in 0.5-<3 year children to 7.84% in 12-<15 year children (Z = 5.0398, P < .0001). The present study showed that HBsAg prevalence among children in Jiangsu has substantially declined since the implementation of enhanced prevention of HBV perinatal infection.

title: Effectiveness of combined intramuscular and intravenous administration of hepatitis B immunoglobulin to newborns in preventing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus
abstract: Abstract Objective While achieving a good success rate of approximately 95% in preventing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV), 10-20% of infants born to HBeAg-positive or high-viral-load mothers still become infected. Study Design To strengthen the prevention of HBV MTCT at birth, intravenous injection was added to the conventional regimen of intramuscular hepatitis B immune globulin (HBIG) administration immediately after delivery, thereby achieving a more rapid rise in blood antibody levels. Vaccination was initiated once antibody titers had declined to a certain level. Results The study method maintained higher levels than existing methods for approximately 4 months post-delivery. No infection was detected at one year of age in the seven HBeAg-positive cases(including two involving in utero infection) and the five cases with high viral loads (≥5.3 log IU/mL). Conclusions Designed to protect newborns from HBV infection by enhancing their defenses against infection immediately after birth, this offers a new option.

title: Enabling Person‐Centred Chronic Hepatitis B Care Among Migrant Men Who Have Sex With Men and Female Sex Workers
abstract: ABSTRACT Aim(s) To explore experiences of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care among migrant MSM and female sex workers attending a specialist sexual health clinic and identify perceived enablers of person‐centred care. Design Qualitative interview study. Methods Semi‐structured interviews with 14 overseas‐born men who have sex with men (MSM, n = 7) and cisgender and transgender female sex workers ( n = 7) attending a publicly funded sexual health clinic in Sydney, Australia. Data were analysed using thematic analysis, with interpretation informed by the Person‐Centred Practice Framework. Results Sexual health services were experienced as safe spaces where CHB was often identified during routine screening, enabling participants to initiate or re‐engage with care. Care engagement was shaped by macro‐context factors including visa status, Medicare access, language needs, culturally embedded understandings of CHB and referral pathways. Trusting relationships with sexual health practitioners supported discussion of sex, migration and CHB, although some interactions were experienced as directive and overly risk‐focused, undermining relational safety. Participants described CHB as having low salience in everyday life but becoming more prominent during intimate moments such as disclosure, partner reassurance and sex work decisions. For some participants, PrEP or HIV therapy offered dual HIV–CHB benefits, making treatment feel more worthwhile and easier to take up. Participants navigated system barriers through peer networks, information‐seeking, and services aligned with their needs. Conclusion Person‐centred CHB care for migrant MSM and female sex workers requires more than clinical monitoring. Care should be responsive to the intersecting effects of migration, sexuality, sex work, intimacy and access to health services, while creating culturally and relationally safe environments that support trust, disclosure and sustained engagement. Implications This study calls for embedding CHB care within routine sexual health and HIV care, strengthening language support, improving referral coordination, and supporting clinicians to use reflexive, non‐directive communication to avoid moralising or ‘risk‐only’ framings. Patient or Public Contribution None.

source_records.title: Enabling Person‐Centred Chronic Hepatitis B Care Among Migrant Men Who Have Sex With Men and Female Sex Workers
source_records.abstract: AIM(S): To explore experiences of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care among migrant MSM and female sex workers attending a specialist sexual health clinic and identify perceived enablers of person-centred care. DESIGN: Qualitative interview study. METHODS: Semi-structured interviews with 14 overseas-born men who have sex with men (MSM, n = 7) and cisgender and transgender female sex workers (n = 7) attending a publicly funded sexual health clinic in Sydney, Australia. Data were analysed using thematic analysis, with interpretation informed by the Person-Centred Practice Framework. RESULTS: Sexual health services were experienced as safe spaces where CHB was often identified during routine screening, enabling participants to initiate or re-engage with care. Care engagement was shaped by macro-context factors including visa status, Medicare access, language needs, culturally embedded understandings of CHB and referral pathways. Trusting relationships with sexual health practitioners supported discussion of sex, migration and CHB, although some interactions were experienced as directive and overly risk-focused, undermining relational safety. Participants described CHB as having low salience in everyday life but becoming more prominent during intimate moments such as disclosure, partner reassurance and sex work decisions. For some participants, PrEP or HIV therapy offered dual HIV-CHB benefits, making treatment feel more worthwhile and easier to take up. Participants navigated system barriers through peer networks, information-seeking, and services aligned with their needs. CONCLUSION: Person-centred CHB care for migrant MSM and female sex workers requires more than clinical monitoring. Care should be responsive to the intersecting effects of migration, sexuality, sex work, intimacy and access to health services, while creating culturally and relationally safe environments that support trust, disclosure and sustained engagement. IMPLICATIONS: This study calls for embedding CHB care within routine sexual health and HIV care, strengthening language support, improving referral coordination, and supporting clinicians to use reflexive, non-directive communication to avoid moralising or 'risk-only' framings. abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 探索前往专业性健康诊所就诊的移民男男性接触者和女性性工作者的 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 护理经验,并确定以人为本的护理的感知推动因素。设计定性访谈研究。方法 对 14 名在澳大利亚悉尼公立性健康诊所就诊的 14 名海外出生的男男性行为者(MSM,n = 7)以及顺性别和变性女性性工作者(n = 7)进行半结构化访谈。使用主题分析对数据进行分析,并根据以人为本的实践框架进行解释。结果 性健康服务被认为是安全的空间,在常规筛查过程中经常发现慢性乙型肝炎,使参与者能够开始或重新进行护理。护理参与度受到宏观背景因素的影响,包括签证状态、医疗保险准入、语言需求、对 CHB 的文化理解和转诊途径。与性健康从业者的信任关系支持了对性、移民和慢性乙型肝炎的讨论,尽管一些互动被认为是指导性的且过度关注风险,破坏了关系安全。参与者将慢性乙型肝炎描述为在日常生活中不显着,但在亲密时刻(例如披露、伴侣安抚和性工作决策)变得更加突出。对于一些参与者来说,PrEP 或 HIV 治疗提供了 HIV-CHB 双重益处,使 治疗 感觉更有价值且更容易接受。参与者通过同行网络、信息搜索和符合其需求的服务来克服系统障碍。结论 针对流动男男性接触者和女性性工作者以人为本的慢性乙型肝炎护理需要的不仅仅是临床监测。护理应应对移民、性行为、性工作、亲密关系和获得医疗服务的交叉影响,同时创造支持信任、披露和持续参与的文化和关系安全环境。意义 这项研究呼吁将慢性乙型肝炎护理纳入常规性健康和艾滋病毒护理中,加强语言支持,改善转诊协调,并支持临床医生使用反射性、非指导性沟通以避免说教或“仅风险”框架。患者或公众贡献 无。

title: Liver concentrations of JNJ-73763989 siRNA triggers in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB): The INSIGHT study panel 3 results
abstract: Background JNJ-73763989 is a 2:1 combination of 2 N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc)–conjugated short interfering RNAs (siRNA) targeting the S (daplusiran) and X (tomligisiran) regions of the hepatitis B virus genome. In phase 2b studies, 48 weeks of JNJ-73763989-based combination treatments led to dose-dependent reductions in viral markers, including hepatitis B surface antigen. The objective of the INSIGHT study Panel 3 was to quantify intrahepatic concentrations of the siRNAs in human livers during and after treatment. Methods In the open-label, single-arm, single-center study, participants with chronic hepatitis B received 48 weeks of treatment with JNJ-73763989 200 mg every 4 weeks and nucleos(t)ide analog, with optional pegylated interferon α2a 180 μg weekly added after Treatment Week (TW) 40. Core liver biopsies were collected at TW12, TW40, and at Follow-up Week (FUW) 24. Results Liver biopsies were available from all 4 participants at TW12 and from 3 at TW40 and FUW24. Between TW12 and TW40, liver concentrations of daplusiran and tomligisiran increased 1.5- to 2.6-fold, consistent with intrahepatic accumulation. abstract_zh: 背景 JNJ-73763989 是一种靶向 乙型肝炎病毒 基因组 的 S(daplusiran)和 X(tomligisiran)区域的 2:1 组合的 N-乙酰半乳糖胺(GalNAc)偶联小干扰 RNA(siRNA)。在 II 期 2b 研究中,基于 JNJ-73763989 的组合 治疗 持续 48 周可导致病毒标志物(包括乙型肝炎病毒表面抗原)剂量依赖性下降。INSIGHT 研究第三部分的目标是量化在 治疗 治疗期间和治疗后,人类肝脏中 siRNA 的肝内浓度。方法 在一项开放标签、单臂、单中心研究中,患有 慢性乙型肝炎 的受试者接受了 48 周的 治疗 治疗,每 4 周给予 JNJ-73763989 200 mg,并联合核苷(酸)类似物治疗,可选择在 治疗 第 40 周后每周添加聚乙二醇化干扰素 α2a 180 μg。核心肝活检分别在第 12 周(TW12)、第 40 周(TW40)和随访第 24 周(FUW24)进行。结果 所有 4 名受试者在 TW12 均提供了肝活检样本,3 名受试者在 TW40 和 FUW24 提供了样本。在 TW12 和 TW40 之间,daplusiran 和 tomligisiran 的肝内浓度增加了 1.5 至 2.6 倍,与肝内蓄积一致。在最后一次 JNJ-73763989 注射后 28 周,仍有 2 名受试者检测到可测量的触发物,其浓度较峰值水平降低了 4.5 至 15 倍,估计肝内半衰期范围为约 2.9 至 16.1 周。结论 这是首个在人类中通过连续活检评估 GalNAc-siRNA 肝内浓度的研究。JNJ-73763989 在人类肝脏中的长期存在可能部分解释了 II 期研究中观察到的病毒参数持续抑制效应。

analysis_zh.main_results: 治疗 第 12 周的所有 4 名参与者以及 治疗 第 40 周和随访第 24 周的 3 名参与者均获得了肝活检。在 治疗 第 12 周和第 40 周之间,daplusiran 和 tomligisiran 的肝脏浓度增加了 1.5 至 2.6 倍,与肝内蓄积一致。最后一次注射后 28 周,3 名参与者中有 2 名仍可测量到触发因素,其浓度较峰值水平降低了 4.5 至 15 倍。

title: Factors influencing breastfeeding intention among hepatitis B virus-infected mothers: An ABC-X cross-sectional analysis
abstract: Despite international guideline recommendations supporting breastfeeding among HBV-infected mothers, breastfeeding rates remain suboptimal. This study investigated factors influencing breastfeeding intention among HBV-infected mothers using the ABC-X theoretical framework. A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2025 among 119 HBV-infected pregnant women. Structured questionnaires assessed demographic characteristics, disease-related factors, social support, self-efficacy, stigma, breastfeeding attitudes, and breastfeeding intention. Descriptive statistics, t-tests, chi-square tests, and multivariate logistic regression were performed. Among participants, 45.3% (n = 54) intended to breastfeed. Univariate analysis showed significant differences in self-efficacy (p = 0.003) and breastfeeding attitude scores (p = 0.046) between mothers with and without breastfeeding intention. After adjustment for potential confounders, self-efficacy was the only independent predictor of breastfeeding intention (OR = 3.71, 95% CI: 1.35–10.19, p = 0.011). The prediction model showed good discrimination, with an area under the ROC curve of 0.782. Maternal self-efficacy was the strongest predictor of breastfeeding intention among HBV-infected mothers. Interventions enhancing self-efficacy and clearly communicating breastfeeding safety with immunoprophylaxis may improve breastfeeding support in this population.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify factors influencing breastfeeding intention among HBV-infected mothers using the ABC-X framework. Conducted as a hospital-based cross-sectional analysis of 119 pregnant women, it assessed self-efficacy, attitudes, and other variables through structured questionnaires. Results showed that 45.3% of participants intended to breastfeed, with significant differences in self-efficacy and attitude scores between groups. After adjusting for confounders, self-efficacy emerged as the sole independent predictor of breastfeeding intention, with an odds ratio of 3.71 and a p-value of 0.011. title: Occult Hepatitis B Virus Infection Among HBsAg-Negative Maintenance Haemodialysis Patients in Malaysia: Association with Anti-HBs Serostatus
abstract: Abstract Background Occult Hepatitis B infection (OBI)—defined as the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA in HBsAg-negative individuals—poses a severe transmission and reactivation risk in haemodialysis units. This study aims to investigate the prevalence and clinical characteristics of detectable HBV DNA among HBsAg-negative maintenance haemodialysis patients, particularly those with anti-HBc positivity. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted involving 2,146 patients who attended the dialysis unit at Universiti Malaya Medical Centre (UMMC) from 1 January 2019 to 30 June 2024. Patients established on maintenance haemodialysis were included, while those with HBsAg positivity or missing data were excluded. Patient demographics, clinical variables, and biochemical information were extracted from the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Data collection was conducted using REDCap version 14.3.13, and statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29.0 and Python version 3.10.16. A Firth penalised multivariable binary logistic regression model was constructed utilising OBI status as the dependent variable to identify independent clinical predictors, addressing potential small-sample bias inherent in standard logistic regression. Results Among 2,146 screened patients, 1,635 patients were included. Anti-HBc IgG positivity was identified in 23.5% (N = 384) of the cohort. HBV DNA testing was not performed in 146 patients under the testing practices prevailing during the study period. Within the tested core-positive subgroup (N = 238), overall OBI prevalence was 9.2% (N = 22). In patients with positive HBV DNA, 54.6% were concurrently Anti-HBs IgG positive (≥ 10 IU/L), and 18.2% possessed an Anti-HBs IgG level ≥ 100 IU/L. The multivariable Firth penalised logistic regression model revealed that while an Anti-HBs titre ≥ 10 IU/L was a significant negative predictor of OBI (OR 0.18, 95% CI 0.07–0.50, p = 0.001), it failed to exclude active viraemia entirely. Conclusion Our study identified an overall OBI prevalence of 9.2% in a tested Malaysian ESKD cohort. Firth penalised logistic regression model utilising OBI status as the dependent variable confirmed that relying solely on Anti-HBs IgG to infer viral clearance is inadequate in this immunocompromised population, especially given that over half (54.6%) of OBI patients maintained Anti-HBs IgG positivity.

title_zh: 马来西亚 HBsAg 阴性维持性血液透析患者中​​的隐匿性 乙型肝炎病毒 感染:与抗 HBs 血清状态相关
source_body_en: Abstract Background Occult Hepatitis B infection (OBI)—defined as the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA in HBsAg-negative individuals—poses a severe transmission and reactivation risk in haemodialysis units. This study aims to investigate the prevalence and clinical characteristics of detectable HBV DNA among HBsAg-negative maintenance haemodialysis patients, particularly those with anti-HBc positivity. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted involving 2,146 patients who attended the dialysis unit at Universiti Malaya Medical Centre (UMMC) from 1 January 2019 to 30 June 2024. Patients established on maintenance haemodialysis were included, while those with HBsAg positivity or missing data were excluded. Patient demographics, clinical variables, and biochemical information were extracted from the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Data collection was conducted using REDCap version 14.3.13, and statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29.0 and Python version 3.10.16. A Firth penalised multivariable binary logistic regression model was constructed utilising OBI status as the dependent variable to identify independent clinical predictors, addressing potential small-sample bias inherent in standard logistic regression. Results Among 2,146 screened patients, 1,635 patients were included. Anti-HBc IgG positivity was identified in 23.5% (N = 384) of the cohort. HBV DNA testing was not performed in 146 patients under the testing practices prevailing during the study period. Within the tested core-positive subgroup (N = 238), overall OBI prevalence was 9.2% (N = 22). In patients with positive HBV DNA, 54.6% were concurrently Anti-HBs IgG positive (≥ 10 IU/L), and 18.2% possessed an Anti-HBs IgG level ≥ 100 IU/L. The multivariable Firth penalised logistic regression model revealed that while an Anti-HBs titre ≥ 10 IU/L was a significant negative predictor of OBI (OR 0.18, 95% CI 0.07–0.50, p = 0.001), it failed to exclude active viraemia entirely. Conclusion Our study identified an overall OBI prevalence of 9.2% in a tested Malaysian ESKD cohort. Firth penalised logistic regression model utilising OBI status as the dependent variable confirmed that relying solely on Anti-HBs IgG to infer viral clearance is inadequate in this immunocompromised population, especially given that over half (54.6%) of OBI patients maintained Anti-HBs IgG positivity.

title: Hepatic Steatosis in People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Africa: Prevalence, Correlates, and Clinical Significance.
abstract: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
authors: Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET)

abstract_zh: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP)。通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关。我们还使用Cox比例风险模型评估了SLD对死亡率的短期影响。此外,我们评估了B型超声波在SLD诊断中的表现,以CAP为参考标准。在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m)。年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关。在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。B型超声波对SLD的敏感性较低,无论是整体还是在严重情况下,但特异性为95%。总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。这些数据支持在非洲HBV管理中纳入代谢性共病的筛查措施以及治疗的监测。

title: Becoming Physically Active and Risks of Mortality and Liver-Related Events in Adults With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
abstract: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.
